blocks.text:
## Rio, the Amazon, Salvador and Iguazu Falls

After Manaus, the route continues to Salvador. Here the programme focuses on Afro-Brazilian culture, the colonial Pelourinho district and the beaches of Praia do Forte. The final days are devoted to Iguazu: first the Brazilian side of the falls, then the Argentine side.

The programme deliberately brings together very different experiences. Rio offers beaches, mountain viewpoints and a colonial centre; the Amazon brings forests, rivers and village life; Salvador introduces Afro-Brazilian traditions and historic architecture; and Iguazu provides a powerful natural finale. Over 13 days, the surroundings change almost every 2–3 days.
